Subject: Your cross-border insolvency matter

Dear Ms. DSouza,

Thank you for meeting us on 9 April 2026 about your dispute with Aravali Holdings Ltd. As we understand it, the debtor is in insolvency proceedings in two countries. The matter is listed before the NCLT Mumbai.

Our advice is to file the claim with the resolution professional before the deadline. Please collect the loan documents and the statement of the amount due and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
